# TikTok Shop

Stores and marketplaces · options checked 2026-10-21 · [how sources are chosen](../../docs/SOURCING.md)

**Nothing to recommend for TikTok Shop yet.**

No official MCP server or agent skills: TikTok publishes only SDKs (tiktok-business-api-sdk) and TikTok Shop API sample apps. The only community repository over 100 stars with a recent commit, xixihhhh/clipforge, makes short sales videos and does not read shop orders or settlements, so nothing is recommended.

[`tiktok`](https://github.com/tiktok) on GitHub publishes no skills or MCP server for agents as of 2026-10-21. That is a dated fact, not a permanent one.
